notes: Followed the multi-step path: Confirm.cshtml form -> POST /checkout/confirm (RouteProvider.cs:316) -> CheckoutController.ConfirmOrder.

The action redirects to one-page checkout when OrderSettings.OnePageCheckoutEnabled is on (line 1291); the installer sets OnePageCheckoutEnabled = true (InstallRequiredData.cs:1870), so with default settings the order is placed by the one-page path (OpcConfirmOrder action, Views/Checkout/OpcConfirmOrder.cshtml), which is not walked here.
The terms-of-service check is only in the page script (Confirm.cshtml); the server does not check it in ConfirmOrder.
PlaceOrderAsync runs placeOrder either directly or under a mutex when OrderSettings.PlaceOrderWithLock is on (O:1681); both run the same steps.

Exceptions thrown while preparing the order details (PreparePlaceOrderDetailsAsync runs outside the placeOrder try) travel to the controller catch; exceptions inside placeOrder are caught at O:1663 and returned as errors, which the controller adds to model.Warnings.
Entity inserts/updates publish EntityInsertedEvent/EntityUpdatedEvent through the repositories; those consumers are not listed.
Not walked: CheckoutModelFactory.PrepareConfirmOrderModelAsync, the PrepareAndValidate* methods, tax and discount computations, ProcessOrderPaidAsync, recurring payments.
